variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/height
variables.description: Checkbox / radio box — 16px square

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/width
variables.description: Switch track width — 48px (twice the 24px track height)

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/dot
variables.description: Radio dot — 12px (0.7 × the 16px box, on the 2px grid)

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/line-box
variables.description: Label line height (body sm, 21px) — the control centers on the label's first line.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/inset
variables.description: Switch thumb inset — 3px ((24px track − 18px thumb) ÷ 2). Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/radius
variables.description: Checkbox/radio corner — 2px, clamped to the 16px box (does not follow the radius scale).

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/track
variables.description: Switch track height — 24px. Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/thumb
variables.description: Switch thumb — 18px (0.75 × the 24px track). Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/sm/label-inset
variables.description: Option row label inset — 0px, so the label's first line centers on the 16px box.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/height
variables.description: Checkbox / radio box — 20px square

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/width
variables.description: Switch track width — 64px (twice the 32px track height)

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/dot
variables.description: Radio dot — 14px (0.7 × the 20px box, on the 2px grid)

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/line-box
variables.description: Label line height (body md, 24px) — the control centers on the label's first line.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/inset
variables.description: Switch thumb inset — 4px ((32px track − 24px thumb) ÷ 2). Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/radius
variables.description: Checkbox/radio corner — 2px, clamped to the 20px box (does not follow the radius scale).

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/track
variables.description: Switch track height — 32px. Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/thumb
variables.description: Switch thumb — 24px (0.75 × the 32px track). Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/md/label-inset
variables.description: Option row label inset — 0px, so the label's first line centers on the 20px box.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/height
variables.description: Checkbox / radio box — 24px square

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/width
variables.description: Switch track width — 80px (twice the 40px track height)

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/dot

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/line-box

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/inset

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/radius
variables.description: Checkbox/radio corner — 2px, clamped to the 24px box (does not follow the radius scale).

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/track
variables.description: Switch track height — 40px. Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/thumb
variables.description: Switch thumb — 30px (0.75 × the 40px track). Switches only.

variables.name: nbds/control/size/lg/label-inset
variables.description: Option row label inset — 0px, so the label's first line centers on the 24px box.

variables.name: nbds/type/label/sm/line-box
